content.text: {"summary":"You have a high-pressure work deadline, a disorganised home, and a missed medical appointment creating overlapping stress across multiple life domains.","urgency":"high","tasks":[{"id":1,"priority":"critical","title":"Reschedule dentist appointment","why":"Health matters and missed appointments compound anxiety.","by_when":"Today"},{"id":2,"priority":"critical","title":"Finish the presentation core slides","why":"Tomorrow's deadline cannot move — minimum viable content first.","by_when":"Tonight"},{"id":3,"priority":"high","title":"Do a 15-minute triage of the house","why":"Visual clutter increases cognitive load; a quick triage reduces background stress.","by_when":"This evening"},{"id":4,"priority":"medium","title":"Set a reminder for any other deferred appointments","why":"Prevent the same problem recurring.","by_when":"This week"},{"id":5,"priority":"low","title":"Deep-clean the house","why":"Nice to have once the urgent items are handled.","by_when":"Weekend"}],"next_action":"Open your calendar right now and reschedule the dentist — it takes 2 minutes and removes a nagging worry.","resources_needed":["Dentist contact number","Laptop for presentation slides","30-minute timer for focused work sprint"],"risks":["Sleep deprivation from late-night slide preparation reduces presentation quality","Skipping the appointment again could escalate a minor issue"]}
